context: Separate original field observations from 2013 MOVECLIM. Published 2023 source already in literature (retrospective, non-pristine); response of this new source is not yet accessed by this Structural analysis. Do not call dataset independence a pristine confirmatory design.

source.source_event_count_conflict: Publisher Data Records says 90 Event, but a Method Step paragraph says 105 Event. Require EXACT 90 independently keyed plots and 1150 Occurrence rows in original archive; never silently rescue by 105.

island_units.each_plot: 100 m2 (10 x 10m), 2017/2018 woody + herbs vascular plant census, 2013 MOVECLIM source not reused as new outcome

eligibility_pre_response: Read only exact zip central directory and meta.xml; verify Event core with eventID, island, original author locationID, forest type field e.g. habitat or samplingProtocol, Occurrence extension with scientificName, establishmentMeans, taxonRank or canonical species join and coreid, and Event↔Occurrence declared join.
Do not open any Event/Occurrence body until field roles, original SHA256, required ontology and all stop rules are frozen.

During one-shot response access require 90 distinct author-defined plots/Events, 10 for each of nine island×forest-type cells, 1150 original Occurrence rows, and fixed 2017/18 year semantics. If mismatch STOP without changing thresholds.
Forest label only source-declared exact strings NF / Natural forest; EW / Exotic woodland; PF / Production forest. Unknown label STOP; never infer forest type from observed taxon composition.

Native includes exactly status endemic, native, indigenous, Azorean endemic and Macaronesian endemic labels if documented; introduced includes exactly introduced, invasive, naturalized and casual if original source ontology; unknown, mixed, subspecies and ambiguous excluded from focal/reference primary and counted.

S1 identity from original frozen 20 Azorean strict Well-supported island-level loss taxa, no species selected by favorable new outcome, species name match unique canonical binomial (no fuzzy synonyms).

focal_analysis.primary_endpoint: Within each of three islands separately, fraction of 10x10m plot×taxon native incidence belonging to fixed history-of-local-loss 20-taxon S1 group, compared NF versus average of EW/PF (forest type supplied independently of plant outcome).
focal_analysis.primary_statistic: For island i and forest type h, f_i,h = focal native taxon-by-plot positives and r_i,h=other native taxon-by-plot positives; logodds_i,h = log[(f_i,h+0.5)/(r_i,h+0.5)]. d_i=logodds_i,NF - (logodds_i,EW+logodds_i,PF)/2. Main D=mean_i d_i across all 3 islands, equal island weights. Fixed smoothing 0.5; positive D indicates compositional enrichment in native forests; do NOT interpret as causal survival/refugia.
focal_analysis.supported_direction: D positive only descriptive if 95% plot-cluster bootstrap lower bound >0 using fixed 2000 stratified plot resamples island×forest; no p-value posthoc sign flip. Bootstrap not three-independent-archipelago support.
focal_analysis.minimum_eligibility: Each of 9 island×type groups has 10 verified independent plots; focal taxon positive in at least 2 islands; at least 2 distinct S1 focal native taxa overall and >=6 native focal plot×taxon positives total; remaining reference native positives in all 9 cells. If not met primary UNSCORED, not evidence of no effect.
focal_analysis.sensitivity: Report per-island d_i, raw focal and other native incidence, total native and alien plot×species richness by type, without raw taxon identities or site IDs; no alternative q-threshold, no retuning.
focal_analysis.competing_explanation: Native forests already known in prior paper to host more indigenous plants; finding a large total-native-richness gradient is PRIOR ART. New nonobvious target is conditional compositional enrichment of historical-loss taxa rather than simply indigenous diversity of forest type.

authorship_ethics: Cite published authors, avoid interpreting forest type as randomized intervention or historical at-risk loss risk; independent 90 plots are ecological frame, not proof of source population persistence/rescue.
do_not_score: Dispersal, source viability, colonization, demographic rescue or native-forest intervention effect
Pico same 2013 v1.281 values as new independent endpoint
